observations.kind: R13-P3 premise refuted for current Gecko: the URL-only refresh reading is pure over-reporting (fail-closed, harmless to the gate)
observations.evidence: Fetched gecko-dev master docshell/base/nsDocShell.cpp (reviewer scratchpad copy, not in the repo): nsDocShell::SetupRefreshURIFromHeader implements the HTML shared declarative refresh steps step by step (skip ASCII whitespace; collect digits; if none and the next code point is not '.', return; collect digits and '.'; if not at the end and the code point is not ';', ',' or ASCII whitespace, return; optional ';' or ','; ExtractURLString with the url=, quote and truncation steps). So current Gecko does not navigate on a URL-only content, and the digit/dot exclusion in legacy_refresh_url (which would have been the one narrowing against the pre-review's wider suggestion) is moot. Consequence: any non-blank refresh content without a delay (for example content='text/html' or content='width') now yields one AssetRef and, if relative, one port call with the Document context. UNVERIFIED for older Gecko versions (the pre-review's recollection) and for Blink/WebKit (not read).
observations.remediation: Lead decision: keep (fail closed, documented in the DESCRIPTOR and the residual 'any non-numeric content is reported as a relative URL'), or drop legacy_refresh_url and its tests. No correctness issue either way; nothing hidden by keeping it.

observations.evidence: The cancellation unit test proves a check inside each loop at its first iteration; a variant that checks only at i == 0 (not every 1024) would pass; the stride is read from the code (assets.rs:673, :697), not from a test. A mid-walk cancel cannot be tested deterministically without a hook, and with the memo a single walk is bounded by the nodes sharing one id. The css_url_gate 20 s assertion on the scan duration is stricter than the 45 s bounded_case it sits in and adds wall-clock exposure on a shared, loaded builder; the deterministic counter test is the real proof.
observations.remediation: None required. If a judge wants less flake surface, the 20 s assertion can go (the 45 s case deadline already fails the old algorithm by orders of magnitude).

observations.remediation: None for this lane. If a project port is Windows-file-based, its own document-refusal should compare canonical file identity, not the string.
